issueReference.title: Telescreen v1.1: features adopted from comparable sensitive-data monitoring systems (F1-F10)
issueReference.intakeCommunication: workflowInput (issue-resolution, no GitHub issue number): FINAL v1.1 RUN, implement only v11-p21-leak-e2e, then archive

reviewContext.userProblem: Telescreen v1 judges content only. DSPM, DLP and secret-scanner products judge risk as content x placement x exposure, confirm resolution by rescan, treat unscanned as unsafe, route to data owners and track exceptions with expiry. The owner asked to adopt F1-F10 as specified in design-v1-1-dspm-adoption.md while keeping every v1 data-handling guarantee. F1-F10 code is integration-accepted at 809b02d; this run proves the leak matrix and end-to-end flows and finishes the release.
requiredOutcomes: Leak matrix extended to new tables, API responses, search documents, notifications, digests and logs with raw-sample, file-name and owner-email canaries (v11-p21 gaps L1-L9).
v1.1 end-to-end flows P1, P2, R1, R2, O1, O2, O3, O4 pass through the assembled app with no xfail, skip or weakened assertion.
The v1 leak matrix (tests/leak/test_leak_matrix.py, tests/leak/flows.py) is unchanged since 809b02d and passes; no src/** change.
mise run ci passes offline; src/web install, typecheck, vitest, build and the screenshot smoke (35 PNGs, zero browser errors) pass.
All v11 plans archived to impl-plans/completed; impl-plans/README.md, README and docs updated (serial finalization).
nonGoals: F11 ticket export, F13 custom classifiers, F16 evaluation harness (v1.2).
F12 automated remediation or any source write scope (owner decision: read-only).
F14 credential validity checks against providers (owner decision).
F15 reveal of raw values (owner decision: deep links to the source location only).
Dependency changes (pyproject.toml, uv.lock, src/web/package.json, bun.lock) and edits to existing Alembic migrations.
constraints: AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, python-coding-standards; plan files under 400 lines; Python files under 1000 lines.
Strict typing via tools/typelint.py, ruff ANN/PGH and ty; no weakening, no type-ignore or ty-ignore comments, no new per-file-ignores.
Raw detected values, file names, paths, titles and emails never persisted, logged, indexed, notified or returned.
Default uv run pytest passes offline; integration tests marked and skipped without TELESCREEN_TEST_DATABASE_URL / TELESCREEN_TEST_MEILI_URL.
v11-p21 writes no src/**; a defect in an accepted plan becomes a reconciliation request against the owning plan in the Progress Log.
Canary strings built at runtime from fragments; canary email domain example.com.
sha256 recorded before and after each edited file (drift protocol).
Conventions 7a: fixed findings only in addressedFeedback; verification lists only final passing commands; offline-skipped integration tests and /tmp outputs are not risks.
designDecisionsAndRationale: R-1: version 1 stays the identity key; only value fingerprints use the active key version, so key rotation never re-keys issues or counts as remediation.
R-2: issues.severity is the effective severity and base_severity is added.
R-3: PATCH can no longer set resolved or ignored; dedicated remediation, resolve and exception operations replace it.
R-5: exception approval through /api/exceptions by teams.lead_member_id or an admin.
R-6: public unscannable resources raise collector health unscannable_public.
R-11: My tasks uses three list endpoints with the assignee=me fix.
R-12: rescanner reports inconclusive for incomplete content; detect maps it to error/scan_incomplete.

Section 12 provider names ExceptionMaintenanceProvider (issues/maintenance.py) and IssuePolicyMaintenance (issues/policy_apply.py) match the current code (design-doc working-tree refinement accepted in comm-000246).
New c2 manifest supersedes c1 because c1 was already dispatched in session 3 with all 21 plans; c2 lists p01-p20 as acceptedDependencies and dispatches only p21 with its declared artifact roots.
intentionalTradeoffs: src/web/node_modules and tmp/ui-screenshots are declared artifactRoots of v11-p21 (gitignored, generated by bun install --frozen-lockfile and bun run screenshots); build outputs go to /tmp per conventions section 7.
The v11-p21 final gates run whole-repository with no tolerances.
supportedEdgeCases: Policy allow then violate: violate wins; policy change moves open -> allowed without counting as remediation.
Rescan with incomplete content is inconclusive and never resolves; resource gone (404) records resource_deleted.
Exception expiry reopens the issue; until_regressed exceptions end on regression.
Fingerprint key rotation with version 1 as identity key keeps issue identity.
Token without a member passing assignee=me gets no unfiltered list.
min_risk escalation below threshold is skipped.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Live PostgreSQL/Meilisearch behavior beyond marked integration tests skipped offline.
Real external services (Slack, Google, GitHub, SMTP, LLM providers) and real docker compose up.
PolicyReevaluateHandler explicit rejection of requested exceptions with decided_by=system (low residual; approving such a request returns 409).
